tickets.title: Bento Box Grid Layout
tickets.description: Constructs an asymmetrical "Bento Box" grid layout utilizing column and row spans.
tasks: Constructs an asymmetrical "Bento Box" grid layout utilizing column and row spans.
learning_objectives: Master Tailwind's CSS Grid utility classes.
tickets.evaluation: `check_class_used("grid-cols-4")` `check_class_used("col-span-2")` `check_class_used("row-span-2")` **[A] Visual (40 pts)**: 40 pts if the grid correctly forms the asymmetrical 2x4 bento layout on desktop. **[B] Logic (40 pts)**: 40 pts for CSS grid span utilities. **[C] Quality (10 pts)**: 10 pts for arbitrary value fallback `h-[600px]` if exact sizing isn't in scale.
hints: Tailwind's grid system uses 'grid' and 'grid-cols-*' utilities.
Use 'gap-*' to add spacing between grid items.
